core_change_summary.description: Migrate from KAPT to KSP for annotation processing; update Gradle wrapper to 8.14; bump kotlinx-coroutines (1.7.3→1.8.1), kotlinx-serialization (1.6.0→1.7.3), lifecycle (2.8.7→2.9.0), work-runtime (2.10.0→2.11.0), glide (4.16.0→4.17.0), okhttp (5.0.0-alpha.2→4.12.0 stable); enable parallel builds and caching in gradle.properties; add OPTIMIZATION_REPORT.md with expected benefits.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line churn is in the optimization report markdown (448 lines total); actual build configuration changes are modest (49 lines in app/build.gradle, 19 in gradle.properties).
